page.overview:
What is Arnold's Van?

is a service van with Fazbear Entertainment branding on it. It's owned by Arnold, and was used during the beginning and some endings of Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic.

Arnold's van is a faded blue work van with a white stripe and a Fazbear Entertainment logo on the back corner. It has two seats with an open back filled with work supplies, shelves, and makeshift work tables. There is a heater hung behind-above the driver's seat that is connected to a propane tank, suggesting the van doesn't have heating. The passenger's seat and floorboard is filled with trash, both from food and numerous cans of soda. There is also a Spring Bonnie bobble head on the dashboard.

At the beginning of Secret of the Mimic, Arnold is seen driving on a open stretch of road when he gets a call from Dispatch who informs him that he has a job at Murray's Costume Manor. After entering the parking lot, Arnold takes out a Data Diver and enters the building.

In the Walk Away Ending, Arnold is allowed to go into the back garage where his van has been moved. He begins to drive off when Dispatch gets in contact and after telling Arnold, promptly fires him. A red light illuminates the back and Arnold looks into the rearview mirror to see that the Mimic has been hiding in the back. Mimic rushes towards him and attacks.
